title: Pack Bar SOC Estimator (Kalman Filter)
text: Average state-of-charge estimator for battery pack with Kalman filter, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Filter type} sets Kalman; {Alpha}, {Beta}, {Kappa}, {Covariance of the process noise, Q} sets the covariance of process noise, {Covariance of the measurement noise, R}, {Initial state error covariance, P0} sets the initial state error covariance, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample, {Charge dynamics} sets the option, {Vector of state-of-charge values, SOC (-)} sets the sOC breakpoints, {Vector of temperatures, T} sets the temperature, {Terminal resistance, R0(SOC,T), (ohm)} sets the r0 lookup table with temperature breakpoint, {First polarization resistance, R1(SOC,T), (ohm)} sets the first RC resistance at temperature breakpoints, {First time constant, tau1(SOC,T), (s)} sets the first RC time constant at temperature breakpoints, {Second polarization resistance, R2(SOC,T), (ohm)} sets the second RC resistance at temperature breakpoints, {Second time constant, tau2(SOC,T), (s)} sets the second RC time constant at temperature breakpoints, {No-load voltage, V0(SOC,T), (V)} sets the v 0 lookup table 3.55, 3.57, 3.56; 3.62, 3.63, 3.64; 3.71, 3.71, 3.72; 3.91, 3.93, 3.94; {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: AverageCurrent
ports.summary: Average current of battery pack, ampere scalar

ports.name: AverageVoltage
ports.summary: Average voltage of battery pack, volt scalar

ports.name: AverageTemperature
ports.summary: Average temperature of battery pack, K scalar

ports.name: AverageAH
ports.summary: Average charge of battery pack, A*Hr scalar

ports.name: InitialSOC
ports.summary: Initial state of charge, unitless scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: SOC
ports.summary: Average state of charge of battery pack scalar

ports.name: Vdyn
ports.summary: Average dynamic overpotential voltage of battery pack scalar

params.name: Filter type
params.values: Kalman filter type Extended Kalman filter (default) | Extended Kalman-Bucy filter | Unscented Kalman filter | Unscented Kalman-Bucy filter

params.name: Alpha
params.values: Alpha coefficient 1 (default) | scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: Kappa
params.values: Kappa coefficient 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 3]

params.name: Covariance of the process noise, Q
params.values: Covariance of process noise [1e-6 0; 0 1e-6] (default) | [1e-6 0 0;0 1e-6 0;0 0 1e-6] | matrix of scalars

params.name: Covariance of the measurement noise, R
Initial state error covariance, P0
params.values: Initial state error covariance [1e-5 0; 0 1] (default) | [1e-5 0 0; 0 1 0;0 0 1] | matrix of scalars

params.name: Charge dynamics
params.values: Option to model battery charge dynamics One time-constant dynamics (default) | Two time-constant dynamics

params.name: Vector of state-of-charge values, SOC (-)
params.values: SOC breakpoints [0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9, 1] (default) | vector of scalars in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Vector of temperatures, T
params.values: Temperature breakpoints [278, 293, 313] (default) | vector of positive scalars

params.name: First time constant, tau1(SOC,T), (s)
params.values: First RC time constant at temperature breakpoints [20, 36, 39; 31, 45, 39; 109, 105, 61; 36, 29, 26; 59, 77, 67; 40, 33, 29; 25, 39, 33] (default) | matrix of positive entries

params.name: Second time constant, tau2(SOC,T), (s)
params.values: Second RC time constant at temperature breakpoints [20, 36, 39; 31, 45, 39; 109, 105, 61; 36, 29, 26; 59, 77, 67; 40, 33, 29; 25, 39, 33] (default) | matrix of positive entries

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
